definition: a person who has killed someone on purpose
description: A wood-panelled courtroom in grey daylight. A middle-aged man in a navy suit and white shirt stands in the wooden dock behind a brass rail with a cold, blank face, his wrists in handcuffs, while a uniformed officer holds his arm. The view moves slowly closer to him. Behind him a woman in black bends over and cries into a dark coat. A woman lawyer in front lays her hand on a thick file next to a water jug, and rows of serious people watch under tall windows.

en.question: What is the woman behind him doing?

de.answer: Sie schluchzt in einen dunklen Mantel.
de.question: Was macht die Frau hinter ihm?

es.answer: Está sollozando contra un abrigo oscuro.
phrases: mirar al frente con la mirada perdida
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer que está detrás de él?

fr.answer: Elle sanglote dans un manteau sombre.
phrases: regarder droit devant soi d'un air absent
fr.question: Que fait la femme derrière lui ?
